data.name: Killing Blow
data.description: At 8th level, weapons you use become infused with the power of death. Whenever you confirm a critical hit with a melee or ranged weapon, your attack deals an additional %1 bleed damage. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|DomainDeathLVL/2|DomainDeathLVL/4-1
